text: The School of Accounting now has two specialties of accounting and financial management, and cultivates postgraduates in partnership with Nanjing University, and coordinates its efforts with Curtin University of Technology to cultivate undergraduates in accounting. The school has about 1500 undergraduate and postgraduate students. Among the 57 full-time teachers, there are 21 professors and associate professors, 12 PhDs (including PhD candidates) and 24 Master's degree holders. In recent five years, 19 treatises and compilations and around 400 theses have been published in journals such as Accounting Research, Management World, Industrial Economy in China and Audit Research. The school has participated in one national standard establishment, fulfilled 20 ministerial and provincial research projects, 2 provincial horizontal projects and been awarded 7 ministerial and provincial prizes. B.A. Accounting Objectives: This program will train the students with the international accounting standards, modern accounting management. The graduates will be qualified for the work of accounting practice, accounting consultation, and research work in all kinds of governmental institutions, domestic and international enterprises and accounting firms. Objects: Four-year Bachelor of Management Degree Main Course: Economics, Management, Statistics, Management Information System, Economic Law, Tax law, Marketing, Monetary and Banking, Elementary (medium, high) Financial Accounting, Cost Accounting, Management Accounting, Auditing, International Comparative Accounting, Accounting Information System, Accounting Statement Analysis, Research of Accounting Cases, Accounting System Design, Financial Management, etc.
